2014_subclasses.fey-wanderer.description: Fey Wanderers are rangers who have learned to tap into the magic of the Feywild. They are adept at traversing the border between the mortal world and the realm of the fey, and they use their connection to the fey to bolster their own abilities and those of their allies.
2014_subclasses.fey-wanderer.dreadful-st: At 3rd level, you can use your connection to the Feywild to mark your foes with otherworldly dread. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage to the target. The damage increases to 1d6 at 11th level.
Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage to the target. (action).
2014_subclasses.fey-wanderer.fey-wandere:
At 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Fey Wanderer Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

3rd: charm person
5th: misty step
9th: dispel magic
13th: dimension door
17th: mislead
The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.
2014_subclasses.fey-wanderer.otherworldl: At 3rd level, your fey connection allows you to project a magical glamour. When you make a Charisma check, you can expend a use of this feature to gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1). You can also use this feature on a Charisma (Deception), Charisma (Intimidation), or Charisma (Performance) check.
Can expend a use of this feature to gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1). (action).
2014_subclasses.fey-wanderer.beguiling-t: Starting at 7th level, the magic of the Feywild safeguards your mind. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw against being charmed or frightened, you can use your reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. If the save fails, the target is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of your next turn.
In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw against being charmed or frightened, you can use your reaction.
2014_subclasses.fey-wanderer.fey-reinfor: At 11th level, the royal courts of the Feywild have noticed you. Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that summons a fey or a beast, the summoned creature gains the following benefits: The creature appears with more hit points than normal: 1 extra hit point per level of the spell. The summoned creature's weapon attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
The summoned creature's weapon attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
2014_subclasses.fey-wanderer.misty-wande: At 15th level, you can use the mystical energy of the Feywild to move between planes. Once per short rest, you can cast the misty step spell, requiring no spell slot or material components. In addition, when you use this feature, you can bring along up to two willing creatures within 5 feet of you, provided you have a way to reach them (such as a rope or chain).
In addition, when you use this feature, you can bring along up to two willing creatures within 5 feet of you, provided you have a way to reach them.
